scope: on-demand synthetic known-answer and fresh-key sanity checks on the existing serialized worker
binding: The runner verifies fresh signed device identity before and after the run and checks role, source, hardware and unchanged boot. The accepted request ID is the run ID; later IDs on one boot must increase.
measurements: stack_free_words is the minimum remaining worker stack in FreeRTOS words since task creation, not an operation-only peak or interrupt-stack measurement. elapsed_ms is null until a target elapsed-time method is qualified. No heap measurement is currently provided.
cancellation: Disconnect requests cancellation without reusing worker memory until the synchronous operation returns. Queued and running cancellation become interrupted; partial results do not become a pass. A stuck SDK call is not interrupted by USB cancellation.
security: The crypto check uses public known-answer vectors and fresh temporary key pairs; it exposes no generated private bytes or traffic keys and accepts no caller-supplied message to sign. The separate identity proofs use the established permanent identity signing interface.
qualification: A passed random sanity check is not proof of entropy. A passed probe is not pairing, radio contention, whole-board memory qualification or C9 lifecycle acceptance.
